# Takeover-Labs (www.takeover-labs.com)

> Takeover-Labs is a premium B2B web design and conversion strategy studio specializing in Framer. We design conversion-focused websites and landing pages for established B2B SaaS companies and consulting firms that want clarity, authority, and enterprise-level positioning.

We do not work with consumer brands, or budget-sensitive projects. We work with operators who treat their website as strategic infrastructure, not a marketing afterthought.

## Services
- B2B Website Design: Full website design and development in Framer for B2B SaaS companies and consulting firms. Focused on conversion, positioning, and enterprise credibility.
- Landing Page Design: Conversion-focused landing pages for B2B SaaS products, GTM campaigns, and lead generation.
- Conversion Authority Review (Takeover Roast): A 48 to 72 hour landing page audit for B2B SaaS and agency founders. Includes a full PDF breakdown, redesigned hero section, and page structure direction. Priced at $149.
- Website Strategy: Positioning, messaging hierarchy, and information architecture for B2B companies preparing for redesign or repositioning.
- Framer Templates: Premium Framer templates for B2B SaaS, consulting firms, and VC funds. Available on the Framer Marketplace and Contra.

## Who We Serve
- B2B SaaS companies with a live product and validated revenue
- B2B consulting firms, strategy firms, and growth advisory businesses
- GTM agencies and marketing agencies
- Companies targeting mid-market or enterprise clients
- Founders and marketing leads who understand positioning and want a website that supports their sales process

## Who We Do Not Serve
- Pre-launch or idea-stage startups
- Consumer brands
- Ecommerce businesses
- Budget-sensitive projects
- Clients looking for aesthetic-only redesigns without strategic intent
